description: Floodplain Ecosystem Service mapper is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGS South Atlantic Water Science Center; Drexel University | Academy of Natural Sciences. This web mapping application helps users assess, quantify, and value the ecosystem services provided by floodplains in the Delaware River and Chesapeake Bay watersheds. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
